table.name: tags
table.purpose: Join table mapping descriptive tags (e.g. genre, era, language, availability) to torrents; each row is one tag applied to one torrent, so a torrent can have many tags and tags repeat across torrents.

id.name: torrent_id
id.description: Identifier of the torrent being tagged; references torrents.id (many-to-one). Repeats across rows because a torrent carries multiple tags.

index.name: tag_id
index.description: Primary key of this table; unique sequential integer identifying each tag-assignment row.

tag.name: tag
tag.description: The tag label applied to the torrent: genres/styles (electronic, experimental, pop, dance), eras (2010s), languages/origins (french, turkish), release types (maxi.single), and availability (freely.available). Dots separate multi-word tags.

table.name: torrents
table.purpose: Music torrent listings (likely from a music-focused BitTorrent site such as a Gazelle-based tracker). Each row is one release/torrent group: artist, release title, year, release type, and download statistics. The 'group' fields mirror Gazelle's torrent-group concept (an artist + album/release), and totalSnatched counts completed downloads.

artist.name: artist
artist.description: Primary artist or artists of the release, lowercase text. 'various artists' (6381 rows) marks compilations; '&' separates collaborations (e.g. 'baauer & just blaze').

groupId.name: torrent group id
groupId.description: External identifier of the torrent group (artist + release) on the source tracker, distinct per row. Not the table's primary key; values cluster in high ranges (e.g. ~72-73 million) suggesting IDs from the original site, while low values (min 5) are older groups.

groupName.name: release title
groupName.description: Title of the release (album/EP/single/mixtape name), lowercase, HTML-escaped in places ('''). Not unique because generic titles like 'greatest hits' or 'remixes' recur across artists.

groupYear.name: release year
groupYear.description: Year the release was published, 1979-2016, with most rows in the 2005-2016 range.

id.name: id
id.description: Primary key of the table, sequential 0-75718 (one row per id). Referenced by tags.id (many tags per torrent).

releaseType.name: release type
releaseType.description: Kind of release: album, single, ep, compilation, mixtape, live album, soundtrack, etc. (15 distinct values).

totalSnatched.name: total downloads (snatches)
totalSnatched.description: Number of times the torrent has been fully downloaded ('snatched' in tracker terminology). Heavily right-skewed: median 30, max 76457.
